prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: coherent double-door state concept sheet for a Chinese 2D top-down prison factory game.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for the CLOSED door material and surrounding workshop walls. Image 2 is a BUG reference, showing mismatched open-door art and ghost remnants above the jambs. Neither is an edit target. Generate a new clean art direction sheet.

Primary request: redesign the workshop entrance as ONE mechanically consistent pair of hinged industrial steel doors. Show CLOSED, HALF OPEN, FULL OPEN views of exactly the SAME door structure, and an enlarged in-game context view of the full-open design. The user must be able to verify that frame, leaf design and hardware match through all states.

Style: match the attached game's hand-painted raster sprite art: worn muted blue-gray steel, restrained rust at edges, thick readable outlines, cream stone coping, stained beige plaster wall and dark charcoal stone base, olive-gray square floor tiles, warm ochre workbenches. Crisp illustrative game sprites, not photorealistic, not a 3D perspective render. Orthographic elevated top-down 3/4 camera with HORIZONTAL wall run and axis-aligned floor tiles as in the reference. Uniform camera and scale between the three state studies.

Layout: landscape polished concept sheet on light warm neutral background. Top strip: three generously sized, aligned entrance studies labeled in clean Chinese typography: "关闭", "半开", "全开". Each study contains an identical short wall segment, same anchored fixed doorframe, identical doorway width, and the two identical steel door leaves only changing hinge angle. Bottom: a larger full-open workshop entrance in context with the existing room style, cropped ochre worktable edges in the background and a small orange-uniform character just outside to communicate scale. One modest title: "一号车间 · 统一双开钢门". One short footer: "固定门框 · 同一对门扇 · 三种状态". No other text.

Door design: plain substantial riveted blue-gray steel frame anchored INSIDE the masonry opening. Same slim flat lintel and two straight jambs in ALL views, ending cleanly at the wall coping without freestanding pale extensions above the wall; coping meets the outer frame sides neatly. Two rectangular blue-gray steel leaves with identical narrow rectangular wired-glass inspection windows at the same height, the same brass vertical pull handles near the meeting edges, exactly three hinges per outer edge. Choose one recognizable subtle dent/scratch per leaf, repeat across views so it is clearly the same physical pair. CLOSED: two leaves meet in the middle, frame remains fixed. HALF OPEN: the same leaves swing toward the workshop interior about 45 degrees. FULL OPEN: same leaves rotate inward about 90 degrees, projecting backward into the room along the side jambs and leaving the central threshold clear. Front/back faces are the same steel family and same window construction. Hinges and thickness must be physically credible; leaves rotate, never vanish, shrink, or get exchanged for a different style.

Constraints: Design consistency is the priority. Fixed frame identical and occupying precisely the same opening in all state studies. Clean layer junctions with the wall: absolutely no duplicated wall pieces or stray vertical pale rectangles above hinges, no vestigial bars across the empty aperture, no second frame behind the frame, no old sprite remnants. Unobstructed central floor in the full-open state. Remove all editor UI, desktop window borders, red markup boxes, circles, guide arrows, and debugging text from reference influence. No hazard stripes, sliding mechanism, sci-fi accents, ornamental arches, or additional doors. This is a concept proposal, not a screenshot of a changed game.
design_intent: Same fixed frame and same leaf construction in all three states.
Separate frame, left leaf and right leaf when making runtime assets; rotate leaves, never replace the whole doorway with separately designed state images.
Retire old door renderers and inherited wall-end/lintel remnants inside the new doorway, preserve existing map draft.
Concept shows proposed result, not current game.
